PDF rendering of the Master List slip for [[Baktoid Armor Workshop (Errata 3)]], front face. It prints the PC-E3 game text (official text as of 27 April 2013), word for word the release-sheet text of [[Baktoid Armor Workshop]] (original). The Master List slip prints no slip number.

== References ==
[https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)], PDF page 23. Wiki copy: [[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf]].

Rendered at 300 dpi from the PDF and cropped to the slip (11 November 2026, Batch R8-U).

== Preservation ==
archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-0/09/VL-history-1274-3-front-master.png Internet Archive item].
